title: polyspec interface contract
description: The public API of one repository in every target language (binding design I-1). Rule ids in descriptions are those of docs/spec/contract.md.

path.description: packages/rust, or packages/<component>/rust when the repository has several cores; the binding packages sit beside it (L-1).

features.description: The features of the core that each target builds it with (I-1); a target without a row builds the default features. A generated crate builds the core with these features only.

targets.description: The targets that the repository generates (I-4).

naming.description: Names that differ from the conversion of N-2 (N-3).

types.description: The value types (T-3) that this contract uses by name, each with the library and the value unit that own it.

faults.description: The fault injection points of the core, which a test feature of the core arms (G-5, X-1): a case names a point as <library>.<id> in its faults.

ruleId.description: A rule id, the only accepted form of a reason (N-3, T-5, I-3, E-1b, U-3, Q-4, C-1).

name.description: A name as a list of words (N-1).

module.description: A neutral module path (P-2), or the empty string for the root of the package; its first segment is not host or tests (L-1).

only.description: The targets where the item exists, with the rule that removes it from the others (Q-4).

native.description: A type-level declaration that the generator cannot compute, per language (I-3).

packages.description: Package names, roots and entries per language (P-1, P-5, P-6).

host.description: L-2a: the language package is a hand-written host package; the binding is its native module at packages/<component>/<lang>/native/, and the host's manifest is checked only for what the native module needs.

L-2a: the language package is a hand-written host package; the binding is its native module at packages/<component>/<lang>/native/, and the host's manifest is checked only for what the native module needs.

L-2a: the language package is a hand-written host package; the binding is its native module at packages/<component>/<lang>/native/, and the host's manifest is checked only for what the native module needs.

oneOf.description: A map whose keys mix the kinds listed (T-2, U-7 (c)).

async_allowed.description: Whether the function may return a Promise or an awaitable (U-3).

errors.description: Error kinds, categories and classes (E-1 to E-2, E-1a, E-1b).

classes.description: The base class of every category in every language but Go, whose category types E-7 fixes (E-2).

fixed.description: The runtime argument errors of G-7, classes with no kind and category type (E-2).

kinds.description: The variants of the core error enum (E-1); a variant of a dependency names its library and takes its category from that contract (E-1b).

library.description: (a) the kind of a dependency, passed on as it is (E-1b).

source.description: (b) the library whose error this kind of the repository holds as its source (E-1b).

kinds.description: The kinds of a variant that gives two or more (E-1); a variant without it gives the one kind of its name in snake_case.

binding.description: Class overrides of the kinds of BindingError (E-1a, E-2).

wrapped.description: For each property of each error unit of a wrapped dependency: forward it or drop it with a rule (E-1b).

when.description: A predicate and its value, or else: the rows or cases of the same kind that no other selects (U-1, U-7 (b), (f)).

make.description: Per language: a built-in form or the id of a public constructor or static factory of a value unit.

oneOf.description: A map whose keys may mix the kinds listed (U-7 (c)).

read.description: A public member, or builtin for a built-in language type (U-7 (e)).

reason.description: The rule that makes a field of type optional<T> optional (T-4, T-5).

callbackErrors.description: The classes whose instances a callback's language code may raise to give the core a known result (U-3); every other exception goes back to the caller unchanged.

result.description: Whether the core path returns a Result (E-1c). Absent, it does when raises names a variant or a parameter is a callback or a function.

failure.description: Whether the error of the core path is binding_core::Failure<E>, a kind or what language code raised (E-1c, GN-7). Absent, it is when a parameter holds a callback or a function; true names a member that calls language code its receiver keeps.

exclusive.description: U-6: the rule by which the core refuses an overlapping call of this member of a &self unit with kind busy.

core.description: A callback: the path of the core trait (U-3). A value alias: the core functions that judge a language value described as HostValue (in: fn(&mut dyn HostValues, HostValue) -> Result<T, Failure<E>>) and give the core value as OutValue (out: a function from &T to (OutValue, V) where V: OutValues may borrow the value) (U-7).

in_raises.description: A value alias: the variants of E-1 that its in function can give (U-7). They join every member that takes the alias, and are not written in raises (E-5).

change.description: A difference from the API of the base commit (C-1).

to.description: The unit or member that replaces the symbol, the new name in each language for a renamed symbol that is no unit or member (such as an error class), or null for a symbol that is removed (RN-4).

case.description: The contract case file and group that run a member (K-1), or that hold the cases of the in function of a value alias (U-7).

result.description: The key of a case of the group that holds the result of the member (G-5, GN-13e); result when the row names none. Only a row with member has it.

fault.description: A fault injection point of the core (G-5): core is the path of the constant that holds its name, which the generated crate names (I-2); inject lists the injections the point takes; fills lists the error kinds that an injection at the point can give; reason is the rule of the condition that the point imitates; place names the function that holds it.

kind.description: An error kind, as Kinds::kind of the core gives it (E-3).
